note: Silhouette scores compare visible boundaries only, not internal geometry, wood, lighting or unseen surfaces. Original controls overall proportions; the accepted side guide directs the head/button join.

internal_features.inspection: Original and selected overlays plus true level head profiles checked against neutral render; topology, junction surface and slit depth independently validated.
internal_features.mitre: The real through-slit was oriented using the dark cut in the original white sprite. Through-rays and the rounded floor were checked.
internal_features.finial: The convex seated button is physically shorter. The front button arc and top silhouette were fitted independently at the original camera.
internal_features.collars: All three front rims were fitted against the original white arc rows, with the rear and side curves constrained by the original outline.
internal_features.lower_body: A wider waist and a shorter span from socket to collar give the stem more body in profile. The widest foot and the original plane of the sole are fixed. The three collar arcs and front groove were cross-checked in the original view.
internal_features.limits: The body outline also overlaps the selected enlargement. The cut, highlights and grain retain visible differences at this camera.
